findings.fix: Cite the place that actually takes the integral closure of an open subring — Wedhorn Definition 7.22, the quotient pair, matching Pair.lean:207 — or drop the References section and name the in-repo use sites (`Huber.Pair.quotient`, `UniformSpace.Completion.isIntegrallyClosedIn_topologicalClosure_map_coeRingHom`).
